title: Corn and Tofu Kebabs
subtitle: crumbed and pan-fried
description: Tofu and corn kernels bound with lentil flour, shaped into small patties, coated in egg and breadcrumbs and fried until golden.

steps.text: Place the corn kernels and roughly chopped tofu in a food processor and pulse, leaving some of the corn kernels whole.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix.
Prepare one bowl with beaten egg and another with breadcrumbs.

Pour oil into a frying pan to a depth of 0.5 cm and heat over medium heat. With clean hands shape small kebabs, dip them in the egg and then in the breadcrumbs. Fry for about 5 minutes on each side until golden, then remove and drain on paper towel.
